title: Practice 8: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **ходили** — past tense (plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
**ходили** — past tense (plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Я ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) над облаками.
exercises.why: **летела** — past tense (feminine) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Из трубы ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) искры.
exercises.why: **летели** — past tense (plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Sparks were coming out of the chimney.

exercises.q: Каким рейсом ты ___ (лететь — to fly, one way)?
exercises.why: **летел** — past tense (masculine) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Аист ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) над городом.
exercises.why: **летел** — past tense (masculine) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: The stork was flying above the city.

exercises.q: Ты слишком низко ___ (лететь — to fly, one way).
exercises.why: **летел** — past tense (masculine) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Мы ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) бизнес-классом.
exercises.why: **летели** — past tense (plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Том ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) вслед за Мэри.
exercises.why: **шел** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Пара ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) рука об руку.
exercises.why: **шла** — past tense (feminine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The couple was walking arm in arm.
